scripts.dev:all: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently --kill-others -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:web -w frontend" "npm run start:dev -w backend"
scripts.present: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently --kill-others -n FRONTEND,BACKEND,TUNNEL -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:web -w frontend" "npm run start:dev -w backend" "node scripts/presentation-tunnel.js"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
